entities.summary: James Edward Baron, Jr. is an American former professional basketball player, and current assistant coach for the San Antonio Spurs of the National Basketball Association (NBA). He played college basketball for the Rhode Island Rams. Standing at 6 ft 3 in (1.91 m), he mostly played at the shooting guard position.
